sets.relationshipLabel: instrument and the component it simply has
sets.explanation: A trumpet has a valve and a clarinet has a reed — each pair names an instrument and the part built into it.

sets.relationshipLabel: a thing and its drawn/diagrammed image
sets.explanation: A formation is captured on a drill chart just as a route is captured on a map — each pair links a real thing to its diagram.

sets.relationshipLabel: the start and end of one span
sets.explanation: Step-off begins a performance and disband ends it, just as warm-up opens a session and finale closes it — each pair bookends the same stretch of time.

sets.relationshipLabel: the cue that lets a group begin its action
sets.explanation: A whistle triggers the cadence and a downbeat triggers the entrance — each pair is a signal necessarily followed by the action it authorizes.
